nodes.label: Optimize SVG Precision
nodes.rationale: Reducing SVG coordinate precision (e.g. 1 decimal place) decreases file size; optimal precision depends on viewBox size. Automate with SVGO (--precision=1 --multipass). Impact: LOW.

nodes.label: SVGO
nodes.rationale: SVG optimizer CLI that automates precision reduction: npx svgo --precision=1 --multipass.
